title: Diared sword
description: A datapack that adds a sword that does 10 damage!
body: This datapack lets you get a sword (with commands) that deals 10 damage! (5 hearts) The command to use this:"/function template:diared" Credits to 100percentme for the templates and mcstacker for the commands. Fun fact: "Diared" stands for "Diamond-Redstone." This is because of the diamond blade and the redstone handle.
